core.title: Forged Iron Egg Knob, Acorn IUQBD

text.description_html:
Acorn IUQBD, Iron Art Egg Knob

This hand forged style reflects the decor of early American and European homes, when all hardware was made by a blacksmith. This Acorn made black iron door knob's unique oblong shaped paired with the clover rose makes it not only beautiful but authentic-looking as well. It will fit all standard pre-drilled doors 1-3/8" to 1-3/4" thick with backsets of 2-3/8" or 2-3/4".

Features and Specifications of the Iron Art Door Knob Set:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Knob Height: 2-1/2"
  • Knob Width: 1-1/2"
  • Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Rose Diameter: 3-1/2"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" to 1-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Sets are complete with tubular latch, two knobs, two roses and are suitable for predrilled doors.

When Selecting a Function:

  • Half Dummy: A stationary knob for use as a pull or to match trim on one side of door. Includes 1 knob, 1 rose, and mounting screws.
  • Passage Set (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates from either side of door. Complete set - 2 knobs, 2 roses, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.
  • Privacy Set (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need locking. Latch operates from either side. Push button on interior knob engages privacy; emergency release hole is on exterior knob. Complete set - 2 knobs, 2 roses, privacy button, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.

Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!
